passages.title: A courtyard worth reading in
passages.text:
At Meranti High School, an unused corner of the courtyard became an outdoor reading area. Students placed benches beneath two existing trees and filled a waterproof box with donated books. They wanted to learn whether a more welcoming space would encourage reading during lunch breaks. Before the change, a student team counted an average of eight readers in the courtyard each lunchtime for one week. During a week after the change, the average rose to nineteen.

The increase was encouraging, but the team was cautious. The second week was cooler than the first, and teachers had announced a reading challenge at the same time. Either factor might have influenced students’ choices. The team therefore refused to attribute the entire increase to the new reading area. Instead, they planned to count readers over several more weeks and ask students why they chose to read outside.

The project also revealed a practical issue. Although the trees provided shade, rain sometimes reached the benches. Students suggested a small roof, but the school postponed that expense until it had stronger evidence that the area would remain useful. For now, volunteers bring the books indoors when heavy rain is expected.

The experience suggests that small changes can make school spaces more inviting. It also shows why an appealing result should lead to further questions rather than an immediate claim of success. A useful experiment does not simply produce a larger number; it helps people decide what to investigate next.

questions.prompt: Pernyataan manakah yang paling tepat menggambarkan gagasan utama bacaan?
choices: A reading challenge always improves students’ examination scores.
A school reading-space project produced promising results that need careful investigation.
Schools should replace all indoor libraries with courtyard benches.
Rain was the only reason students avoided reading outdoors.
questions.explanation: Teks menjelaskan kenaikan jumlah pembaca yang menjanjikan, menimbang penyebab lain dan keterbatasan praktis, lalu menyimpulkan bahwa diperlukan pengamatan tambahan.
questions.evidence: It also shows why an appealing result should lead to further questions rather than an immediate claim of success.

questions.prompt: Mengapa tim tidak menganggap seluruh peningkatan disebabkan oleh area baca baru?
choices: They had not counted any readers before the change.
The donated books were missing during the second week.
Cooler weather and a simultaneous reading challenge could also have influenced reading.
The school had already removed the benches.
questions.explanation: Paragraf kedua menyebut dua perubahan lain, yaitu cuaca lebih sejuk dan tantangan membaca. Keduanya mungkin ikut memengaruhi hasil sehingga sebab tunggal belum terbukti.
questions.evidence: The second week was cooler than the first, and teachers had announced a reading challenge at the same time.

questions.prompt: Pada paragraf 2, kata “attribute” paling dekat artinya dengan …
choices: connect as an effect to a cause
describe in a fictional story
divide into equal groups
remove from a record
questions.explanation: Tim tidak mau menyatakan bahwa area baru menyebabkan seluruh peningkatan. Attribute di sini berarti mengaitkan suatu hasil dengan penyebabnya.
questions.evidence: The team therefore refused to attribute the entire increase to the new reading area.

questions.prompt: Apa simpulan yang masuk akal tentang keputusan sekolah menunda pembangunan atap?
choices: The school believes reading outdoors is harmful.
The school has decided to close the reading area permanently.
The school knows that rain never affects courtyard reading.
The school wants more evidence before committing additional money.
questions.explanation: Sekolah menunggu bukti lebih kuat bahwa area baca tetap bermanfaat sebelum mengeluarkan biaya tambahan; bukan berarti sekolah menentang kegiatan membaca.
questions.evidence: the school postponed that expense until it had stronger evidence that the area would remain useful.

questions.prompt: Pada paragraf 4, kata “it” dalam “it helps people decide” merujuk pada …
choices: A larger number
An immediate claim of success
A useful experiment
A school courtyard
questions.explanation: Frasa yang dirujuk adalah a useful experiment pada klausa sebelumnya, bukan larger number atau courtyard.
questions.evidence: A useful experiment does not simply produce a larger number; it helps people decide what to investigate next.
